title: Define safe deterministic export semantics
description: Specify and implement exact-snapshot versus overwrite behavior for existing export directories, prevent export destinations from overlapping active .wtp storage, remove or report stale files deterministically, and cover the policy on Unix and Windows.

comments.author: Codex
comments.message: Defined dedicated exact-snapshot export semantics: atomically replace current UUID JSON files, deterministically remove stale managed files, preflight and report sorted unmanaged entries without changes, and reject resolved-path overlap with active .wtp storage (including Unix symlink aliases and Windows case variants). Documented failure/portability behavior. Verified focused/full tests, go test -race ./..., Windows-target compilation, and ./scripts/check.sh (pass).
